answer: Clone keys stay cheap when one origin tale covers every alias. Admission deeds a single plot on the windward ridge of a communal garden; that plot binds only one live key. The key delivers a live fable to three keepers 104 minutes apart. After a 13-minute hearing, keeper k posts recite_k = sha3-256(plot||audio_root||keeper_pk||slot_k). The deed locks 19 POA for 7 epochs; each recital costs 0.44 POA. Auditors rebuild occupancy, lantern spacing, and keeper disjointness. A shared plot, reused keeper, or precomputed audio_root cuts 27 percent to that keeper and freezes the key 10 epochs.
